title: Pirkanmaa: €371,240 a year, about 2.3 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)
markdown:
# Pirkanmaa: €371,240 a year, about 2.3 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)

> About 2.3 deaths avoided a year (modelled) · €371,240 of €1M · €628,760 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Pirkanmaa, 32 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. No stage of the care path is below the national level beyond chance. [^care_curative] There is no shortfall to close: Pirkanmaa is at or above the share treated to cure in the best quarter of counties. [^model] More patients are operated than in Finland as a whole, 21.2% against 15.0%, [^care_surgery] and fewer have no treatment on record, 17.9% against 27.5%. [^care_no_record] This plan therefore ranks measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model]

## The target

This plan is ranked by deaths avoided: about 2.3 a year (range −0.2 to 6.2), for €371,240 a year. [^model] Deaths avoided are modelled from stated assumptions, not observed. [^model] The low end is below zero: how much delay adds to lung cancer deaths is not statistically certain, so no benefit cannot be ruled out. [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | Deaths avoided a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Standardised lung cancer pathway with booked slots**[^ev_cpp_pathway_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology (county pathway); FICAN and the national lung cancer group (national pathway description) | €100,000 | 0.8 (−0.4 to 3.0) | Name one pathway owner and book fixed weekly CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots for suspected lung cancer. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 38.7 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| 2 | **Smoking cessation started at the first specialist visit**[^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1]. Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology | €101,240 | 0.8 (0.2–1.8) | Write the standing order: every smoker with suspected lung cancer leaves the first visit with cessation medicine and a nurse call booked. | Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027 |
| 3 | **Same-day chest X-ray report with immediate CT**[^ev_same_day_cxr_ct_1]. Chief radiologist together with the chief physician of primary care | €109,000 | 0.5 (−0.0 to 1.4) | Agree with radiology that a suspicious chest X-ray is followed by CT the same day, without a new referral. | Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027 |
| 4 | **Nurse navigator for every suspected lung cancer**[^ev_nurse_navigator_1]. Head nurses of pulmonology and oncology; director of nursing | €61,000 | 0.2 (−0.0 to 0.2) | Name one nurse who books every test for each new suspected lung cancer patient and calls the patient with the dates. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 38.7 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€371,240** | **2.3 (−0.2 to 6.2)** | | |

Effects are modelled from published studies and stated assumptions, not observed here. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €1,666,730 a year; modelled to avoid 2.9 deaths a year (0.7–7.6). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 38.7 days → 36.9 days by 2028. [^care_time_to_treatment][^model]
- Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027. [^model]
- Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027. [^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €628,760 buys nothing more in the model. [^model] €371,240 a year already buys every measure that adds deaths avoided in Pirkanmaa, and the measures left add nothing or cost more per death avoided than the plan's limit. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 187 deaths a year in Pirkanmaa, and this plan is modelled to avoid 2.3 of them (range -0.2 to 6.2). [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 125 new patients and 99 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 0 of them (0 to 0) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 31.9% to 31.9% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are modelled assumptions, not measurements. The range runs from every assumption at its lowest to every assumption at its highest, and it is not a probability. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for the share of residents aged 65 or over, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, smoking or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- None of 3 measured outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock in the expected direction beyond chance. [^model]
